title: Default terminal falls back to platform-integrated profile
why: defaultProfile is a single shared string (darwinIntegratedDefault / zsh). On Linux that profile is platform-incompatible, so the ribbon and open-terminal.default open a profile picker instead of launching. This edit: when the configured default is missing or not compatible with A2.CURRENT, fall back to Profile.defaultOfType("integrated", profiles, CURRENT) — so Linux auto-opens linuxIntegratedDefault and Mac keeps using darwinIntegratedDefault when set. Only if no platform-integrated profile exists does the picker still open. Independent of 003/004; anchors on original upstream text.
